title: 10x XL Value Fantasi | Bar Juice Salts Bundle
description:
Fantasi 10ml Bar Juice Nic Salt E-Liquid Bundle Pack:
If you’re a fan of our Fantasi nic salt vape juices in 50/50 mix and the double flavour concentration of bar juices, then you’re going to love this bundle! We’ve combined our delicious bar juice flavors in Fantasi 10ml bottles so you can save money while stocking up on your absolute favourite E-liquids.
Spearmint Ice-Classic spearmint flavor served over a super-cool bed of ice.
Lemon Peach & Passion Fruit-
Sweet peaches, tarty lemon and incredibly juicy passion fruit.
Straw Raspberry  & Cherry Ice-
tantalizing trio of juicy, succulent fruits supercooled.
Straw Ice Cream –
Silky, smooth ice cream blended with rich, juicy strawberries.
Tropical Punch Ice-
An exotic fruit medley with notes of citrus and a cool ice finish.
Blueberry Bubblegum Ice-
Ripe, juicy blueberries with sweet notes of nostalgic bubblegum.
Red Grape Ice-
Packed full of authentic notes of succulent red grapes with a cool ice finish.
NRG Ice-
Distinctive, refreshing taste of energy drink.
Mad Blue-
A delicious blend of mixed berries with a touch of cool ice.
Gummy Bear-
Fruit jelly candy flavours with a cool ice finish.
Fantasi Bar Juice E-Liquids are perfect for people looking for a high nicotine dose without the unpleasant throat hit associated with higher-strength E-Liquids. These E-liquids deliver many of the delicious flavor’s found in your favorite disposables – only this time they come in 10ml bottles, so you can enjoy the same great flavor but in a cheaper, refillable device.
For the smoothest vape imaginable, Fantasi Salts are manufactured with 50% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 50% VG (Vegetable Glycerine). You can get yours in 10ml bottles with either 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength.
Nic Salts perform best in devices with coils greater than 1ohm in resistance, such as POD Kits, Vape Pens, and Starter Kits.Because nicotine salt E-liquid is stronger and thinner than standard E-liquid, it is not recommended to use it in a Sub-Ohm device.
Ingredients
Vegetable Glycerine (50%)
Propylene Glycol (50%)
Vapoholic Bar Juice Flavouring
Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Spearmint Bar Juice
1x Lemon Peach & Passion Fruit Bar Juice
1x Strawberry Raspberry & Cherry Bar Juice
1x Strawberry Ice Cream Bar Juice
1x Tropical Punch Bar Juice
1x Blueberry Bubblegum Bar Juice
1x Red Grape Bar Juice
1x NRG Ice Bar Juice
1x Mad Blue Bar Juice
1x Gummy Bear Bar Juice
Specifications:
Ratio
50/50
Size
50ml
Nicotine Strength
10mg, 20mg
Highlights:
10x best-selling Fantasi bar juice E-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 50/50 mix for pod devices and vape starter kits
Double the flavour concentration to replicate the taste of disposable vapes
10 popular 10ml E-liquids bundled together to save you even more money!
